source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: What passes from attention to the feed-forward network inside a transformer block?

options.text: New vocabulary entries for each token
options.feedback: Changing a representation does not create a new vocabulary entry. The same token can have successive internal representations.
The block operates on numerical arrays using learned parameters. It does not pass a set of written meaning rules between its parts.
The intermediate material is numerical. Attention and the feed-forward network transform representations before the model chooses an output token.
Sentences are the visible result of generation. Inside the block, the model is still transforming numerical representations.
